subject: [Action Required] Solatomics - Intermittent 503s observed (status page update)
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena@solatomics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API errors observed this morning

Hi Marcus,

Heads up — our engineering team started seeing intermittent 503 responses from the Redwood hosted inference endpoint (api.redwood.ai/v1/generate) around 07:58 PDT and we've continued to see spikes through the 08:10-08:18 window. We captured multiple request IDs (e.g. req_2f7a3c9, req_2f7a3cf) and have attached a short sample of logs to this email.

Impact: production traffic for a small subset of customers is seeing ~5-7% elevated error rate (mostly 503) with short retries recovering. This is affecting our customer-facing summarization feature for a handful of enterprise accounts.

Can you confirm if Redwood has an incident posted? If not, we need a status page entry and a short customer-facing note. Our ops team is on call and available to share logs/trace IDs.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Head of Platform Reliability
Solatomics

--
Elena Ramos
Elena@solatomics.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Folks, forwarding Solatomics' note — they're seeing a small but noticeable spike in 503s this morning (sample IDs in Elena's email).

Thanks — Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:02:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: API errors observed this morning — Solatomics

Confirming we've seen the same signal in our monitoring: a transient spike in 503s in us-west-2 originating from a momentary prefetch worker backlog between 07:55–08:14 PDT. Top-level findings so far:
- P95 token processing latency elevated for ~19 minutes, correlated with increased prefetch queue depth.
- No evidence of degraded model weights or disk I/O; GPU utilization stayed within expected bounds.
- Automated retries recovered most requests; we saw retry amplification for a small subset (~0.6% of total requests) when clients retried aggressively.

I posted the incident to the status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/SOL-20280615 (Live). Draft text I pushed: 
"Investigating — Customers may experience intermittent 503 errors for hosted inference in US-WEST-2 between ~07:55–08:15 PDT. Our engineers are diagnosing a prefetch queue backlog impacting request servicing for short periods. Retries are succeeding for most requests. We will update this page with root cause and timeline when available."

I've attached a small archive of relevant logs and the prefetch queue metrics extract (ops-logs-20280615.zip). Suggest we send the following brief to Solatomics to confirm we've acknowledged and posted a status update: 

--- suggested reply to customer ---
Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We have posted an "Investigating" incident on our status page and our engineers have identified a prefetch queue backlog in us-west-2 as the likely cause. We're actively mitigating and will follow up with a timeline and root cause. 

Would you like a quick call with our on-call engineer?
--- end suggested reply ---

I'll continue to monitor; will flag if we need to escalate to a rollback/activation of additional prefetch workers.

— Marissa
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops-logs-20280615.zip

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@solatomics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: API errors observed this morning — Solatomics (status page posted)

Elena — thanks again for reporting and for the log snippets. We've posted an Investigating incident to our status page (link below) and our on-call engineers are actively working mitigation steps. Initial mitigation (added prefetch workers and adjusted queue backpressure thresholds) appears to have reduced the error spike; retries are returning to normal levels.

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/SOL-20280615
Immediate mitigation steps taken: added +20% prefetch workers in us-west-2, tuned backpressure window to smooth bursts, monitored retry amplification.

Next update: we'll post a follow-up within 2 hours with timeline and preliminary root cause analysis. If you'd like a short call between your ops team and mine to walk through the logs, say the word and we'll set something up.

Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as a priority.

Best,
Marcus Lin
SVP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
